# Cloud Architecture Report

**Project:** Project management SaaS (B2B, EU)
**Selected option:** Container on Fargate
**Region:** eu-central-1
**Generated by:** AI Cloud Architect v0.1.0

## Requirements

Project management SaaS for small teams. ~5,000 users in the EU in year one. GDPR mandatory. Budget under $500/month. Real-time notifications planned.

## Extracted Constraints

| Constraint | Value |
|---|---|
| Traffic profile | Medium |
| Data type | Relational |
| Latency sensitivity | Standard |
| Compliance | GDPR |
| Budget tier | Standard ($50-500/mo) |
| Region | eu-central-1 |

## Architecture: Container on Fargate

| Service | Role |
|---|---|
| Amazon CloudFront | CDN in front of the app and API |
| AWS WAF | Web application firewall on CloudFront |
| Amazon Cognito | User authentication |
| Application Load Balancer | Routes traffic to containers, TLS termination |
| Amazon ECS Fargate | Runs API and web containers without managing EC2 |
| Amazon RDS PostgreSQL | Primary relational database, Multi-AZ |
| Amazon ElastiCache Redis | Session cache and hot-path reads |
| Amazon S3 | User file uploads |

## Diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    User(("Users"))
    WAF["AWS WAF"] --> CF["CloudFront CDN"]
    CF --> ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    ALB --> ECS["ECS Fargate"]
    ECS --> RDS[("RDS PostgreSQL")]
    ECS --> REDIS[("ElastiCache Redis")]
    ECS --> S3[("S3")]
```

## Cost Estimate

**$260 - $480 / month** (eu-central-1, on-demand)

| Category | Low | High |
|---|---|---|
| Compute (Fargate) | $110 | $190 |
| Database (RDS) | $95 | $160 |
| Cache (ElastiCache) | $25 | $55 |
| Networking | $20 | $50 |
| Storage | $5 | $15 |
| Security (WAF) | $5 | $10 |

## Security

**Posture:** Strong baseline. All compute and data in private subnets; encryption at rest (KMS) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).

**Top risks:**

1. **[HIGH]** GDPR data residency — pin all services to eu-central-1 via SCPs
2. **[MEDIUM]** S3 misconfiguration — enable account-level Block Public Access
3. **[MEDIUM]** Web-layer attacks — keep WAF managed rules updated
4. **[LOW]** No audit trail — enable CloudTrail with log validation

## Scalability

- **Bottlenecks:** RDS primary writer (~5k writes/sec), Fargate quotas, Redis micro size
- **Strategy:** Scale stateless containers horizontally; add RDS read replicas before sharding
- **Ceiling:** ~50,000 concurrent users before database sharding

## Why this option

Relational data model maps naturally to PostgreSQL. Fargate removes OS management for a small team. Predictable latency, portable architecture, and a stack any future hire already knows. GDPR satisfied by region pinning + KMS encryption.
